citations.assessment: The named Rav Mesharshiya’s son addresses Rava. Compare the prior objection attributed to the Barnish speaker addressing Rav Ashi. Each dialogue has a separately framed question.

holds.raw: א"כ רבא בר משרשיא אמר לרבא זקינו
holds.reason: Chullin does call Mesharshiya a son of Rava. Nazir’s wording does not identify that Mesharshiya as the father of its speaker. Keep the grandfather inference provisional alongside the chronological objection.

holds.raw: וצ"ע כי אמר לרבא מן פרכא שהקשה רבא מברניש לרב אשי
holds.reason: The two folios print both dialogues and the discussions are consecutive. Neither dialogue specifies that one is a historical report of the other. Kiddushin supplies the traditional birth/death synchronism invoked here.

notes.text: Separate names and speech turns remain visible. The proposed kinship and the chronological argument stay attributed.
